advice.payment_to_personal_account: Never send money to a personal mobile wallet or bank account. A legitimate organisation collects payment through a defined process, with a receipt.
advice.guarantee_language: Nobody can guarantee a visa. Hearing that promise is itself the warning — do not pay.
advice.cash_payment_requested: Cash leaves no evidence and is very hard to recover. Do not hand over a single taka without a receipt.
advice.visa_class_inconsistent: You cannot work on a visit visa or a so-called “free visa”. Do not travel for work without the correct work visa or permit.
advice.agency_not_licensed: Ask for the agency's licence number and check it. Never pay recruitment money to an agency without an active licence.
advice.cost_above_declared: Every job has a maximum lawful cost to you. If more is demanded, do not pay it — report it.
advice.contract_differs_from_offer: Compare the final contract against the salary and role you were shown. If they differ, get help before signing.
advice.offer_document_unverifiable: A logo or a stamp does not make a document real. Confirm directly with the issuing organisation through its official channel.

site.heroTitle: Before you move abroad, know what is true.
site.heroLead: Check the offer in your hand, see every known cost, understand who receives your money, and follow the next safe step — with the source shown beside every answer.
site.heroVerifyCta: Verify a job or a visa
site.actionsTitle: What would you like to do?
site.statsTitle: What is on the platform today
site.statsNote: Job, employer and agency records are demo data — this is not real recruitment. The country, route and official-source registries are real.
site.howLead: Four steps. At each one you know what is happening, why, and what comes next.
site.how1Body: Enter a verification ID, an agency licence, or paste the message. We compare it against verified records — and tell you what we could not check.
site.how2Body: Who pays what, who receives it, under which rule, and whether it is refundable — every line separately. No hidden fees.
site.how3Body: Which route is open to you is computed from versioned rules and official sources. When we cannot be sure, we say "we don't know" instead of guessing.
site.how4Body: Money moves through a licensed financial institution and is released only against a verified milestone. Every payment leaves a receipt.
site.trustLead: These are constraints, not features — and they are enforced in code.
site.trust1: You see every known cost before you commit to anything.
site.trust2: Who earns each fee is never hidden from you.
site.trust3: Nobody can pay to rank higher in what you are shown.
site.trust4: Your personal data is never sold.
site.trust5: AI can explain a result; it can never make something "verified".
site.trust6: An organisation cannot delete a complaint made against it.
site.guidesLead: Free to read, no account needed. Every fact carries its official source and the time it was last verified.
site.guideCountriesBody: Which routes exist for each country, what they require, and where that country stands right now.
site.guideOccupationsBody: Where your trade is in demand, what qualifications it takes, and what the pay looks like.
site.guideSafetyBody: Eight recognisable traps — what to stop at, and exactly what to do instead.
site.orgLead: Foreign employers, licensed agencies and institutions can submit evidence into one governed review queue; government access remains agreement-gated.
site.orgEmployersBody: A verified candidate pool, evidence of skills, transparent recruitment costs and a compliance record.
site.orgAgenciesBody: Demand management, digital contracts, document workflow and audit-ready records.
site.orgGovernmentBody: Less informal cash leakage, faster complaint investigation, and real data on what migration costs.
site.orgStatus: Evidence intake is operational. Every organisation, licence, fee and opportunity remains unpublished until an independent reviewer approves it; no partnership is implied.
site.faq1A: No. It does not replace government services. BMET and OEP run their own processes and those are final. We read official sources and explain them.
site.faq2Q: Can you get me a visa?
site.faq2A: No, and nobody can. Visa, admission and work-permit decisions belong to the destination country's authority. Anyone promising otherwise is showing you the clearest sign of fraud.
site.faq3A: The core worker-safety features are free or very low cost. Lawful costs — government fees, medical, passport — are itemised separately, and we say who receives each one.
site.faq4A: No. Personal data is never sold or passed on as a lead. What an organisation can see depends on your permission, and you can withdraw it at any time.
site.faq5Q: What if I have been cheated?
site.faq5A: Report it as early as you can and keep your evidence — messages, receipts, documents. The organisation complained about cannot delete the complaint. The help page lists the next steps.
site.faq6A: No — this is under construction. Countries, routes and official sources are real; job, employer and agency records are demo data and clearly labelled. Never pay anyone on the basis of demo data.
site.ctaLead: One verification ID or one pasted message is enough. In seconds you will see what matched and what did not.
site.footerLegalNote: This platform guarantees no visa, no admission and no job.
site.aboutLead: Infrastructure that makes the path from Bangladesh to work or study abroad understandable, verifiable, costed honestly — and much harder to exploit.
site.studyLead: Routes, costs and preparation for studying abroad. This part is still being built — what exists is verified, and what does not exist we say plainly.
site.aboutWhy1: Much of the journey from Bangladesh is already digital. What is missing is trust: whether the job is real, what it should cost, and where the money actually goes.
site.aboutWhy2: A worker still hears about a job from an unregistered intermediary, pays cash without a receipt, and sees the contract for the first time at the airport.
site.aboutWhy3: The goal is narrow and specific: make the lawful path easier than the informal one.
site.aboutBuildBody: Migration Passport, Work and Study readiness, country/route/program discovery, operational journeys, secure documents, cost ledger, deadlines, family access, fraud checks, human-review and support queues, partner evidence intake and outcome governance.
site.aboutNotBuiltBody: Government integrations, regulated real-money movement, malware scanning, independent reviewer staffing and live partner data still require external agreements, credentials and legal approval. The platform shows these gates instead of simulating them.
site.legalNot1: Not a government service, and not a replacement for BMET/OEP.
site.legalNot2: Not a recruiting agency and not an education agent.
site.legalNot3: Not an immigration lawyer and not a visa consultancy.
site.legalNot4: Not a bank, wallet, remittance service or lender — we do not hold your money.
site.legalNot5: No government or institutional partnership is claimed.
site.legalStatusBody: Final terms and a privacy notice will be published after legal review, and reviewed in Bangla. Until then, do not enter real personal data here.
site.orgNotAvailable: Evidence intake is open; publication requires independent review.
site.orgIntakeTitle: Submit evidence to the governed intake
site.orgIntakeLead: Declare the legal entity, source, mandate and every fee. The submission stays pending until a separate reviewer approves it.
site.orgEmployersNeed: Valid company registration, a job demand, contract terms, and an explicit statement of who bears the recruitment cost.
site.orgAgenciesNeed: An active recruiting licence, a verifiable job demand, and a legal basis for every taka collected from a worker.
site.orgGovernmentNeed: A legal basis for data sharing, access scoped to your authority, and an audit record of every access.
site.studyStatus: This section has the structure for verified institutions and courses, but all of the data is demo. Do not make a real admission or tuition decision from it.

experience.questionsLead: Every safe journey begins by answering these questions in order. If one answer is missing, stop before money leaves your hands.

experience.q2Body: See the lawful total, every line item, who pays it, who receives it, and whether it can be refunded.
experience.q3Body: Know the payee, the rule behind the charge, the milestone it belongs to, and the receipt you must receive.
experience.q4Body: Follow one clear step at a time, in the right order, with help available whenever the facts are incomplete.
experience.pathsEyebrow: Choose a route, not a promise
experience.pathsLead: Work and study have different rules, costs, timelines and risks. Compare the path before you commit to one.
experience.journeyEyebrow: One calm step at a time
experience.journeyTitle: A safe journey should be easy to explain.
experience.journeyLead: The platform turns a complicated process into four visible stages. You always know what changed, what was checked and who acts next.
experience.step1Body: Start with a message, document, licence number, job ID or institution name — whatever is already in your hand.
experience.step2Body: We compare each claim with the relevant record and show both what passed and what remains unverified.
experience.step3Body: Review the full cost before committing. Unconfirmed charges stay visibly unresolved and cannot quietly become a payment.
experience.step4Body: Complete the next task, keep the family co-pilot informed, save receipts, and ask a person when the rules cannot decide.
experience.proofTitle: Trust is not a badge. It is a chain of evidence.
experience.proofLead: Every important answer should reveal its source, date, verification level and limits. The platform says “not confirmed” before it says something convenient.
experience.proofDisclosure: These counts describe the current research and demo environment. Nothing is presented as human-verified worker guidance yet.
experience.familyBody: A trusted family member can follow progress, costs and payment alerts without taking control of your application.
experience.faqLead: The most important questions deserve direct answers. If a fact is unknown, the product should say so plainly.

intent.chooseTitle: Which path are you looking at?
intent.chooseLead: Work and study are two different routes, with different requirements, costs and timelines. Look at both before you choose.
intent.workSummary: A verified demand from a foreign employer, processed through a licensed agency, ending in a work visa or permit. In most cases you begin earning once you arrive.
intent.studySummary: Admission to a recognised institution, proof of tuition and living costs, and a student visa. You pay first and earn later, and work rights are limited.
intent.compareLead: The same questions answered side by side — so the decision is made by comparison, not by whoever spoke to you last.
intent.compareWhoWork: People with a practical trade or experience who need income to start soon.
intent.compareWhoStudy: People with academic qualifications looking to raise them and take a longer route.
intent.compareNeedWork: Passport, BMET registration, medical, a skills test or certificate depending on the occupation, and a verified job offer.
intent.compareNeedStudy: Certificates and transcripts, a language test, an offer of admission, and proof of funds.
intent.compareMoneyWork: There is a lawful ceiling on what it may cost you, and recruitment cost often belongs to the employer.
intent.compareMoneyStudy: You must show tuition and living costs up front, and any scholarship has to come from a verifiable source.
intent.compareTimeWork: Usually a few months, depending on the route and the employer.
intent.compareTimeStudy: Usually a year or more, tied to intake seasons and exam dates.
intent.compareRiskWork: Fake job demands, being sold work on a visit visa, and a contract that changes at the last moment.
intent.compareRiskStudy: Fake offer letters, tuition demanded to a personal account, and guaranteed-visa claims.
intent.compareVerifyWork: The employer, the agency licence, the job demand, the salary, and your maximum lawful cost.
intent.compareVerifyStudy: The institution's accreditation, its official domain, the course details, and the payment instructions.
intent.notSure: If you are unsure, read both. Anyone telling you to hurry is the first warning sign.
intent.workHubLead: Routes for working abroad, where the demand is, what it costs, and how to check an offer.
intent.studyHubLead: Routes for studying abroad, which institutions and courses, which exams, and what it costs.
intent.testsNote: Which exam applies depends on the route and the institution. This list is orientation only — confirm the requirement on the institution's own official source.

supply.title: Partner portals
supply.lead: Employers, recruiters, institutions and service providers operate under the same verification, consent and complaint rules—money can never buy eligibility or trust.
supply.employerBody: Job demand, consented candidate pipeline, compliance, offers and post-placement outcomes.
supply.recruiterBody: Licences, job orders, fee declarations, document workflow, receipts, complaints and outcomes.
supply.institutionBody: Official programme feeds, limited consented applications, document completeness, interviews and enrolment.
supply.providerBody: Transparent services, prices, licences, refunds, receipts and publishable safety incidents.
supply.governanceLead: The commercial model is subordinate to the trust infrastructure—not the reverse.
supply.organicTitle: Fit, evidence, cost, freshness and outcomes
supply.organicBody: Organic ordering uses only verified, explainable signals; safety risk always overrides outcomes.
supply.promotionBody: Any paid promotion requires a clear label and placement separate from organic results.
supply.neverSoldTitle: Eligibility, verification, risk or personal data
supply.neverSoldBody: No subscription or referral fee can alter any of these four things.
supply.workflow1: The partner declares official evidence and every fee
supply.workflow2: MFA-authenticated staff submit it for review
supply.workflow3: An independent reviewer checks sources and limits
supply.workflow4: Complaint and outcome monitoring continues after approval
supply.dashboardBody: Portals manage demand, fees and applications, while candidate data requires explicit, revocable consent.
supply.intakeLead: Submit an organisation, licence, job order, programme, service or source change with evidence and a full fee declaration. Submission never means verification or publication.
supply.feeDeclaration: Every fee, payer, payee and refund rule
supply.reviewBoundaryBody: The submitting organisation cannot award itself a verified badge, change organic rank with payment or access candidate data without specific consent.

outcomeIntelligence.costMatched: Did the actual cost match the plan?
outcomeIntelligence.notes: What was different, useful or unsafe?

outcomeIntelligence.noReports: No outcome has been reported from this account yet.

outcomeIntelligence.consentBody: Providing an outcome is optional, purpose-specific and later revocable.
outcomeIntelligence.reviewBody: Self-report never enters ranking directly; it is checked against evidence and the case.
outcomeIntelligence.aggregateBody: Small cohorts, individual records and misleading mixed-currency totals are not published.
outcomeIntelligence.rankBody: Outcome is a bounded signal; complaints, suspensions and verification gaps can override it. Payment influence is zero.
outcomeIntelligence.dashboardBody: Privacy-protected cost and promise-match intelligence from consented 90/180-day outcomes.
